rows.title: Story points: typing an unreadable number such as '2,5' (a decimal comma) erases the issue's points instead of keeping them
rows.summary: Now: if the Story points field holds text the number field cannot read ('2,5' in Firefox or Safari, '1e' or a lone '-' in Chrome), pressing Tab or Enter keeps the saved points and the field shows them again. Before, the browser reported that text as '', and the field took it as a clear. PointsInput's commit (src/components/board/IssueFields.jsx) now reads the input's validity.badInput from the blur or Enter event and leaves the value alone when it is set. A field that is really emptied still clears the points, and a valid number still saves. The fix covers both the issue view's Details and the Create issue dialog.

rows.title: Project settings: a fractional WIP limit ('2.5') silently removes the column's limit, while the board's own limit dialog saves it as 2
rows.summary: Now: 2.5 typed into Project settings → Columns → WIP saves a limit of 2, the same as the board's limit dialog. wipOf in src/utils/boardOps.js rounds a finite number of 1 or more down, where before it returned null (no limit) for any fraction. Anything under 1, or anything that is not a number, still means no limit. The settings page's CommitField (src/pages/BoardSettings.jsx) also no longer commits when the number field reports unreadable text ('2,5' in Firefox or Safari, which arrives as '' with badInput set), so that text keeps the saved limit instead of clearing it. Emptying the field on purpose still removes the limit.
